title: Rocky Road Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Cocoa and dark chocolate chocolate base; almonds, gelatine-free marshmallows and chocolate folded in after churning.
summary: Our classic custard method turned into a dark chocolate base with cocoa and melted chocolate, then loaded with roasted almonds, gelatine-free marshmallows and chocolate chunks after churning.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the paste
steps.text: In the heatproof bowl, whisk the yolks, cocoa and half the sugar into a thick paste with no lumps. If it is too stiff to whisk, loosen it with a spoonful of the cream.

steps.title: Heat the dairy
steps.text: Warm the cream, milk and remaining sugar in the saucepan over medium heat until steaming, stirring so the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Whisk the hot dairy into the cocoa paste a ladle at a time, then pour the lot back into the pan. Diluting the paste gradually keeps the cocoa smooth and the yolks tender.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir over low heat for 5-8 min, until the custard coats the spatula and the thermometer reads 77-80 °C. The cocoa makes it look thicker than it is, so trust the temperature.

steps.title: Melt and flavour
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the 60 g chocolate, the vanilla and the salt until glossy. Melted chocolate adds body as well as flavour.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Sieve into a bowl set in the iced water, stir until cool and refrigerate for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn and fold
steps.text: Churn until thick like soft serve, then scrape into a cold bowl and fold in the almonds, marshmallows and chopped chocolate with the spatula. Folding by hand stops the machine breaking up the mix-ins.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Transfer to the container and freeze for at least 4 h, until firm enough to scoop.

tips: Fold the chilled almonds, marshmallows and chocolate into the ice cream after churning rather than adding them to the machine, where they jam the paddle and sink.
Check the marshmallow label: many contain gelatine, so choose a gelatine-free (vegetarian) brand.
Chill the mix-ins in the freezer first so they do not melt the soft ice cream.
A common mistake is adding the mix-ins to the churning machine; they jam the paddle and sink. Fold them in afterwards.
Hazelnuts or walnuts work in place of almonds.
storage: Freeze, covered, for up to 2 weeks; the marshmallows stay soft for the first week and slowly firm after that.
